entities.summary: Ferdinand Adolf Kehrer was a German gynecologist who was a native of Guntersblum in Rhenish Hesse. He was the father of Ferdinand Adalbert Kehrer (1883–1966), a neurologist and Hugo Ludwig Kehrer (1876-1967), a German art historian.
